Nadia (CS): Hey team — quick sync on HarborLynx private deployment week0. Network team finished basic peering but we still need: egress NAT IPs, route propagation confirmation, and a firewall SR for outbound 443->Redwood control plane IP ranges. KMS: customer wants monthly rotation; current CMK denies our role arn:aws:iam::987654321098:role/Redwood-Access. Audit logs: default retention is 30d in our template, customer requested 365d and wants logs in their S3 with prefix redwood/audit. Renewal note: account is in trial ramp; projected tokens look like 25% of expected baseline this month. If they sustain >40% for two weeks we should start AE outreach.

Evan (Customer): Quick replies: we'll use TGW for edge, NAT egress block is 54.210.0.0/18 (stable). We'll create an S3 bucket harborlynx-redwood-logs and give write policy. Happy with monthly KMS rotation. I put the role we want allowed in the CMK to be arn:aws:iam::555555555555:role/HarborLynx-Infra. I can also add Redwood's role if you tell me exact ARN.

Priya (Network): Thanks Evan. TGW attachment ID and route table IDs requested. Which subnets will host the private endpoints? We need the private link subnet IDs and the expected MTU. Also confirm whether you want health checks from our LB (we poll /health every 30s). For firewall SR: I'll open only 443 and 5263 (internal telemetry) unless Ops asks for broader ranges.

Liam (Security): On CMK: current policy is restrictive. Suggested statement to add:
```
{
  "Sid": "RedwoodAccess",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Access"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
  "Resource": "*",
  "Condition": {"StringEquals":{"kms:CallerAccount":"555555555555"}}
}
```
Please confirm if you want us to instead scope by keyAlias alias/harborlynx-redwood. Also note: exporting audit logs to their S3 with 365d retention will increase egress and S3 costs — capture in account health.

InfraBot: Created ticket HLX-2021: "harborlynx private deploy: TGW routes + CMK update + firewall SR" assigned to Priya, Liam.

Nadia (CS): Action list: 1) Evan to post TGW attachment ID, subnet IDs, and grant S3 write perms (Evan). 2) Priya to submit SR for firewall & confirm LB healthcheck config (Priya). 3) Liam to post CMK policy diff and ask Evan to add Redwood role ARN if needed (Liam). 4) I'll log renewal/risk: set a watch for 40% commit threshold and flag AE if exceeded (Nadia). Goal: do a connectivity smoke test Friday 09:00 PST.

Evan (Customer): I'll add the TGW attachment and subnet IDs by EOD and attach the bucket policy. Also please share the Redwood role ARN so I can add it.

Priya (Network): Filed SR-7742 for firewall exceptions to 111.222.111.0/24 (control plane) and 111.222.112.0/24 (telemetry). Set to open 443 and 5263 only. Will update HLX-2021 when SR is approved.

Liam (Security): Posted CMK policy patch in HLX-2021 and requested explicit ARN from Redwood: arn:aws:iam::111222333444:role/Redwood-Access. Also recommended enabling CloudTrail log file validation for 365d retention. Evan — if you want stricter rotations we can propose 90-day.

Nadia (CS): Thanks all. Noting risks: 1) CMK update pending — blocks KMS-wrapped secrets for the private runtime. 2) Audit retention mismatch — ops and cost implications. 3) Firewall SR approval timeline could push smoke test. I'll escalate AE watch if usage tick hits our threshold. Reopening if blockers surface. :spiral_calendar:
